source: Spin inclination 68.1 degrees from the line of sight (src/objects/flegetonte/source/measurements.json, spinInclinationDegrees: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.846 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.928. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.) and rotation period 12.3 d at the equator (src/objects/flegetonte/source/measurements.json, rotationPeriodDays: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 102195 (pscomppars): rotation period 12.3 d, from Ge et al. 2006 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2006ApJ...648..683G/abstract)): the values the star's magnetic maps are fitted with, with the north pole tilted toward us. The direction of the axis on the sky is not measured; it is placed toward celestial north as a convention. Longitude 0 faces the Sun as a display convention.
coordinateSystem: ICRF/J2000. +Z is the spin axis above; +X is the display meridian; east longitude. No spin is propagated.
qualification: The tilt of the spin axis is measured; its position angle on the sky and the rotation phase are display conventions.
